_comment: Source of truth for this service's entire RabbitMQ topology (event-contract.md). This adapts kart-platform/docs/services/kart-shipping-service/message-bus-manifest.json's draft (which used an older { exchange, dlx, retry, dlqs } shape) to the schema Kart.Shared.Messaging's MessageBusManifest actually parses ({ exchanges[], externalExchanges[], publishedEvents[], queues[], deadLetterQueues[] }) - same correction kart-payment-service's own manifest already documents making. ShipmentDispatched/ShipmentCreationFailed are published via this service's own EF Core/PostgreSQL transactional outbox (OutboxRelayHostedService), which retries indefinitely until RabbitMQ is reachable rather than dead-lettering - per event-standards.md's 'never a shared/global DLQ' rule, each consumer (Order, Delivery Tracking, Analytics, Notification) declares its own per-event DLQ in its own manifest, not here. The CQRS read-model sync (MongoDB) is NOT a self-consumed queue like kart-payment-service's - it is an in-process poller reading shipment_outbox directly (see contracts/README.md), because the internal CarrierCallRequested marker (needed so Pending shipments are visible in the read model) is never published to RabbitMQ at all.
